question: 'Finding My Way' is a famous autobiography written by which of the following Gond artists of India with the help of Mukul S Anand?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Venkat Raman Singh Shyam.__**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• 'Finding My Way' is a famous autobiography written by ***Venkat Raman Singh Shyam.***
 
• He is a contemporary Indian artist who works with murals, etchings, mixed media, and animation. Venkat has traveled extensively and exhibited his work in India and the world over.
 
• He was awarded the Rajya Hasta Shilpa Puraskar by the Government of Madhya Pradesh​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Dhavat Singh Uikey is a Gond artist from Madhya Pradesh. Even though he studied engineering, Uikey's passion for Gond art inspired him to pursue a career
 
• Bhajju Shyam is an Indian artist, belonging to the Gond-Pardhaan community of Madhya Pradesh. He was awarded India's fourth highest civilian award the Padma Shri in 2018. He was a contemporary of the celebrated Pardhaan artist Jangarh Singh Shyam and began his artistic career in Bharat Bhavan, Bhopal.
 
• Jangarh Singh Shyam was a pioneering contemporary Indian artist credited with being the creator of a new school of Indian art called Jangarh Kalam.
